name: Gearbox
text: Adopt Qwen3-235B-A22B-Instruct for EXCAVA. Its MoE design cuts latency 30-40% versus dense models while matching or exceeding quality on benchmarks—directly raising throughput for real-time tasks. Trade-off: it needs careful batch sizing to avoid GPU memory spikes, but the speed gain outweighs the tuning effort.

name: Torque
text: Qwen3-235B’s MoE latency claim ignores sharding overhead—EXCAVA’s 8xA100 node can’t hide the 235B parameter explosion, so batch sizing won’t save you from OOM crashes. Swap to DeepSeek-R1-671B on the same hardware: it’s dense, stable, and already tuned for 8xA100, cutting risk without chasing vaporware claims. Run a 100k-token batch test—if it holds, adopt it; if not, default to the proven stack.
